title: Indian Lotus Root Curry
description: A creamy and flavorful curry made with lightly fermented lotus root, perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: Lotus root
ingredients.amount: 1 medium, peeled and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add ginger and garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add lotus root and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add yogurt and stir well to combine.
Add turmeric powder and salt, and stir well to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the lotus root is tender.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
